checks.name: 111 classifications retain original states, date provenance and valid source/event references
Six exclusive groups cover all cases with reviewed counts
Only explicit service closures are red; trial ends and selection withdrawals stay separate
Mixed technology/service states and negated or planned endings are handled explicitly
Older operating records and republished results do not become current operation confirmations
One map defaults to all cases; each category can be selected independently
Status persists through map filters, pagination, timeline links and case return routes
Historical event-year filters retain latest status semantics and exact original dates
Each detail keeps its original wording and exposes scope, reason and evidence date
